assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting
The denial under CO-197 for missing precertification is contested
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197, indicating that the required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the context of the documented supraventricular tachycardia and underlying coronary artery disease
The diagnosis code I25.10 is asserted for atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The balance amount of 702.81 is asserted
